_comment: Non-secret example config for the #5199 CLI uplift evaluation. Copy, adjust and pass with --config. NEVER put a password, token, ExternalId or key in this file: credentials arrive as short-lived Actions/EC2 role sessions, and fixture secrets are fetched at run time from Secrets Manager by name. config.validate() refuses any credential-shaped key structurally, so a paste here fails the offline guards rather than reaching a commit.
_targets: The approved dev test infrastructure. expected_revision is overwritten per dispatch (CLI_UPLIFT_EVAL_EXPECTED_REVISION / the workflow's required input) with the integrated revision under test; results are bound to whatever is set here. The value below is the revision dev was serving when it was last reverified — read from the deployment's own pinned image, not from a health endpoint, since the product's /health reports only {status: healthy}. Reverify before a live run rather than assuming this is still current; dev moves.
_ec2: The approved test VPC and private subnet. The subnet has no public IP mapping and required regional FIPS endpoints, which is why sts_endpoint/secrets_endpoint default to the -fips hostnames.
_instance: The disposable instance's profile and size. The profile must grant SSM plus this evaluation's own reads and NOTHING else: the CLI journeys must obtain AWS access through the product's own connect flow, because that flow is what E04/E05/E06 are testing. A profile with pre-granted Bedrock access would let a broken connect flow still show working inference. Preflight resolves this name before any mutation, so a wrong value fails while the run is still read-only.
_bounds: Every one of these caps a real cost or a real hang. instance_ttl_minutes must not expire before max_run_minutes, or the recovery sweep could terminate a live run's instance.
_providers: Pinned CLI versions so a provider release cannot silently change what the evaluation exercised.
_fixtures_absent: second_destination_account, github.* and the hosted keys are deliberately ABSENT here. No isolated GitHub evaluation App/org/repo fixture has been established for this handoff, and an absent fixture must BLOCK the cases that need it (E07, E09-E12) rather than be approximated by something weaker that passes. Supply them via the CLI_UPLIFT_EVAL_* repository variables once the fixtures exist. Never point these at a shared App: resetting one would break real users, and a seeded token is not a login.
